description: One data row of central/named_exceptions.csv and manager/{manager_key}/named_exceptions.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

audience.description: Audience the rule delivers to: central or manager.

condition.description: What the rule tests: month_cost_ref_above, breaker_events_at_least or spike_events_at_least.

manager_key.description: person_key of the person's manager; empty if none.

person_key.description: person_key of the person the rule selected.

rule_id.description: Id of the named-exception rule from the policy.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

threshold.description: The rule's threshold, as written in the policy.

value.description: The person's value for the rule: a cost_ref or an event count, as condition says.

title: gold-dataset-named_exceptions
x-cost-column-rule: `value` is a cost for `month_cost_ref_above` and a count otherwise; do not sum across rules.
x-grain: One row per month, rule and selected person.
